tagline.zh: 附着在其他控件角上的状态计数:数字封顶 99+、归零隐藏、可降级为小红点——徽标的一切默认值都在替用户收敛信息密度。
tagline.en: A status count attached to the corner of another control: capped at 99+, hidden at zero, degradable to a red dot — every default is converging information density on the user's behalf.

origin.zh: 规格对齐 Ant Design Badge(antd 6.7.1,经 out/design-study/06-antdesign.md §4.17 + 本地 `.scratch/antd06` 源码复核):overflowCount 默认 99(Badge.tsx:70 缺省、:112 拼 `+`)、dot 默认 false、count 为 0 默认隐藏(showZero 默认 false)、offset 为 [number,number] 且默认 -(index.zh-CN.md:47-52)。任务参数名 max 对应 antd overflowCount。
origin.en: Spec aligned with Ant Design Badge (antd 6.7.1, verified via out/design-study/06-antdesign.md §4.17 plus the local `.scratch/antd06` source): overflowCount defaults to 99 (Badge.tsx:70 default, :112 appending `+`), dot to false, count hides at 0 (showZero defaults to false), and offset is [number, number] with no default (index.zh-CN.md:47-52). This entry's param name max maps to antd's overflowCount.

effect.zh: JS 型参数。默认 8 为演示值(antd count 无官方默认);antd 语义:count 为 0 时默认隐藏(showZero 默认 false),大于封顶值时显示 `${overflowCount}+`(index.zh-CN.md:47)。demo 把 count 挂在按钮与头像两个宿主的角上。
effect.en: JS-type param. The default of 8 is a demo value (antd count has no documented default); antd semantics: count hides at 0 (showZero defaults to false) and shows `${overflowCount}+` past the cap (index.zh-CN.md:47). The demo pins count to two hosts: a button and an avatar.

effect.zh: JS 型参数。默认 99 对齐 antd overflowCount 的官方默认 99(index.zh-CN.md:51;Badge.tsx:70);超过封顶显示 `99+`。任务参数名 max 是本条目参数名,antd 原名为 overflowCount(5.x/6.x 均无 maxCount,调研已核实为「未证实」命名)。
effect.en: JS-type param. The default of 99 matches antd overflowCount's documented default of 99 (index.zh-CN.md:51; Badge.tsx:70); past the cap the badge renders `99+`. max is this entry's param name; antd's original is overflowCount (no maxCount exists in 5.x/6.x — the research records that name as unverified).

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后切换 data-dot)。antd dot 默认 false(index.zh-CN.md:49):不展示数字、只有一个小红点,适合「有新内容但数量不重要」;dot 模式同样遵守 count 为 0 隐藏。
effect.en: JS-type param (demo subscribes and toggles data-dot). antd dot defaults to false (index.zh-CN.md:49): no number, just a small red dot, for 'new content exists but the amount doesn't matter'; dot mode also hides when count is 0.

effect.zh: CSS 变量型参数(--bd-offset 经 translate 消费)。antd offset 为 [number, number] 双值且默认 -(index.zh-CN.md:50);demo 简化为单值同时作用于 x/y 两轴的额外平移,方向语义以 antd 官方文档为准,此处仅演示「偏移可调」的能力。
effect.en: CSS-variable param (--bd-offset consumed via translate). antd offset is a two-value [number, number] with no default (index.zh-CN.md:50); the demo simplifies it to a single value applied as extra translation on both x/y axes — the direction semantics follow antd's docs, and this only demonstrates that the offset is tunable.

note.zh: 本条目仅用 div + CSS(absolute 定位、translate、border-radius、min-width 药丸形),全浏览器基线能力,无特性开关要适配;真正要守的是宿主角上的裁剪(宿主 overflow: hidden 会剪掉徽标)。
note.en: This entry uses only div + CSS (absolute positioning, translate, border-radius, min-width pill) — baseline in every browser, nothing to feature-detect. The real guard is clipping at the host corner (a host with overflow: hidden will cut the badge off).

fallback.zh: 徽标被宿主裁剪时,给宿主留 padding 或把徽标改为 inset 定位;纯视觉徽标必须随附可见文本或 aria-label 表达数量,否则计数信息只活在视觉层;小红点不得作为传达关键信息的唯一手段(颜色不是唯一指示,WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.1)。
fallback.en: If the host clips the badge, give the host padding or switch the badge to inset positioning; a purely visual badge must travel with visible text or an aria-label carrying the count, or the number lives only in the visual layer; a red dot must never be the sole carrier of key information (color is not the only indicator, WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.1).

use.zh: 消息/通知入口的未读计数(按钮、Tab、图标角上),封顶 99+ 收敛大数字
use.en: Unread counts on message/notification entries (buttons, tabs, icons), capped at 99+ to converge big numbers

use.zh: 头像角上的状态点(在线、有更新),数量不重要时降级为 dot
use.en: Status dots on avatars (online, has updates), degraded to dot when the amount doesn't matter

use.zh: 数字本身有信息量时用 count(购物车件数、待办条数);数量不重要时用 dot
use.en: Use count when the number itself informs (cart items, todo count); use dot when only presence matters

avoid.zh: 把长期不变的数字钉在角上——徽标是「需要处理」的信号,常驻即噪音
avoid.en: Pinning a never-changing number on a corner — a badge signals 'needs attention'; permanent display is noise

avoid.zh: 多个宿主同时挂满徽标——徽标的注意力价值随数量稀释,一屏留两三个以内
avoid.en: Saturating many hosts with badges at once — attention value dilutes with count; keep two or three per screen

avoid.zh: 小红点承载关键且不可恢复的信息——dot 无内容无详情,关键信息要走列表/横幅
avoid.en: Red dots carrying critical, unrecoverable information — dots have no content or detail; critical info belongs in lists/banners

a11y.zh: 对读屏,徽标不是独立控件而是宿主的可访问名称的一部分:在宿主上补 aria-label(如「收件箱,8 条未读」)或用 antd Badge 的语义包裹;count 为 0 时视觉隐藏,读屏同样不应播报「0」;小红点必须配宿主文本状态(不能只靠颜色,SC 1.4.1);徽标底色 #ff4d4f 与白色数字对比约 3.9:1,作为大号粗体数字满足 WCAG 大文本 3:1,但小字号数字建议加深底色。
a11y.en: To screen readers a badge is not a standalone control but part of the host's accessible name: add aria-label on the host ('Inbox, 8 unread') or wrap with antd Badge semantics; when count is 0 the badge hides visually and readers shouldn't announce '0' either; red dots must pair with host text state (never color-only, SC 1.4.1); the #ff4d4f fill against white digits is roughly 3.9:1 — fine for large bold digits at WCAG's 3:1 large-text bar, but darken the fill for small digits.

goal.zh: 复刻一枚计数徽标:挂在按钮与头像的右上角,数字按 max 封顶为 `99+`、归零隐藏、可切换为小红点,offset 可微调位置;宿主语义完整(aria-label 携带未读数)。
goal.en: Replicate a count badge pinned to the top-right of a button and an avatar: numbers capped at `99+` by max, hidden at zero, switchable to a red dot, with a tunable offset; hosts stay semantically complete (aria-label carries the unread count).

acceptance.zh: count > max 时严格显示 `${max}+`,不做四舍五入或静默截断
acceptance.en: count > max renders exactly `${max}+`, no rounding or silent truncation

acceptance.zh: count = 0 时徽标整体隐藏(dot 模式同样),宿主不留空位
acceptance.en: At count = 0 the badge hides entirely (dot mode too) with no reserved hole on the host

acceptance.zh: dot=on 时显示无数字小红点,颜色同为 #ff4d4f(antd colorError seed)
acceptance.en: dot=on renders a numberless red dot in the same #ff4d4f (antd colorError seed)

acceptance.zh: offset 通过 CSS 变量注入 translate,参数改动即时可见
acceptance.en: offset is injected through a CSS variable into translate and reacts to parameter changes instantly

acceptance.zh: 宿主按钮/头像保留完整可访问名称,徽标信息不与宿主文本重复播放两遍
acceptance.en: Host button/avatar keep a complete accessible name; badge info isn't announced twice on top of host text
